sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The purpose of this panel is to deliver critical legal services, and support the Secretary's statutory child protection functions to deliver the following:

- Streamlined access to specialised legal services across NSW

- Quality legal representation

- Support efforts to reduce the over-representation of Aboriginal children in out-of-home care

- Ensure vulnerable children and young people can access legal entitlements, including Victims Support.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Department of Communities and Justice (DCJ) invites suitably qualified and experienced legal service providers to apply for inclusion on a panel for the provision of specialist legal services across New South Wales.

The panel will support DCJ's statutory child protection functions by providing access to specialised legal expertise and high quality legal services.

Services will be procured under the following sub-panels:

Sub-Panel 1: Children's Court Advocacy

Provision of legal representation services on behalf of DCJ in Children's Court proceedings. These services are essential to enable DCJ to meet its statutory obligations under the Children and Young Persons (Care and Protection) Act 1998 (NSW).

Sub-Panel 2: Advice and Claims (Legal Entitlements)

Provision of services to review documentation and provide advice on potential legal entitlements for children and young people in out-of-home care including on the lodgement of Victims Support Scheme claims, where instructed by DCJ.

The panel will provide ongoing access to specialist legal services that support vulnerable children and young people across New South Wales.

To participate in the tender opportunity, please register on https://justice.bravosolution.com/web/login.html.

Organisations who have not registered on Procurement Central will not be able to access the tender information.

If your organisation has already registered on Procurement Central, you are not required to register again.

If you require assistance with registering on Procurement Central, you may contact the Customer Support via below methods.
